title: Income Tax Ordinance [New Version]
source_id: דמ״י תשכ״א, 120 (New Version, 5721-1961); early amendments at ס״ח תשכ״א, 47 and 122; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000944; Wikisource page פקודת מס הכנסה
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints פקודת מס הכנסה [נוסח חדש]; metadata gives דמ״י תשכ״א, 120 plus ס״ח תשכ״א, 47 and 122, and Knesset lawitemid 2000944; the amendment list runs to תשפ״ו (2026) with multiple entries that year. On withholding, the structure read from the section headings is: Part X (חלק י׳) 'Payment and collection', Chapter One, 'Deductions on account of tax' (ניכויים על חשבון המס), with Sign א׳ deduction from dividend and interest (ss 164-166), Sign ב׳ deduction from salary and other income (s 167), Sign ג׳ deduction from a foreign resident (s 168), Sign ד׳ auxiliary powers (s 169), Sign ה׳ further provisions (s 170).
notes: MANDATE-ERA ORDINANCE, not a Knesset Law: the parent instrument is the Mandate Income Tax Ordinance, and the operative text is the Hebrew New Version (נוסח חדש) published in דיני מדינת ישראל in 5721-1961, which is why the printed title carries [נוסח חדש] and no Hebrew year in the heading. It is nevertheless the central personal and corporate income tax statute and is amended by ordinary Knesset amending Laws (תיקון מס׳ ...), now past no. 270. On the question asked: withholding sits in BOTH places. The DUTY to deduct at source is imposed by the Ordinance itself, ss 164-170 (Part X, Chapter One), and s 164 is the general obligation with s 169 the auxiliary/regulation-making power; but the RATES, tables, thresholds, credit points and mechanics of deduction from salary are in regulations made under those sections, principally תקנות מס הכנסה (ניכוי ממשכורת ומשכר עבודה), התשנ״ג–1993 (ק״ת תשנ״ג, 408) - recorded in topic_gaps. An encoding of withholding that stops at the Ordinance will have the obligation but none of the arithmetic.
